acceptanceCriteria: Every MCP server built on internal/mcp/server that can return an oversized tool result either bounds it at the tool layer or receives a typed output-bound error from the shared server, never a generic -32603.
A test per affected server (or one shared server test) proves an over-limit tool result yields the typed refusal naming the byte bound.
body: Residual of V1-1996 (#1255, PR #1262). internal/mcp/server/server.go maps errOutputLimit (line ~490/512) to a generic JSON-RPC -32603 internal error when a tool result exceeds the frame limit. V1-1996 fixed this only for the corpus bridge by bounding results in corpusbridge.boundedQuery; other MCP servers sharing internal/mcp/server still surface an oversized result as -32603. Suspected exposure, not reproduced outside the corpus server.
title: Shared MCP server maps an oversized tool result to generic -32603 instead of a typed output-bound error
